battle.name: 隋末農民戰爭
battle.brief: 大業六年冬，山東饑荒，鄉民先聚眾自保；大業七年十一月王薄於長平倡義，河北竇建德、河南瓦崗李密相繼而起，隋廷屢平復叛，兵戈遍及山東、河北、河南。洛陽、涿郡、太原三城以弓弩、投石與連弩守城，攻城屢挫；城破之日，官軍重械盡為起義軍所收，十八年隋室東遷，終為唐所代。

kit.name: 秦連弩
kit.history: 弩機把拉力存起來，一踩一發。守城的一方靠它把攻城的人壓在牆外。

countries:
隋朝一方以中央十二大將軍與五軍宿衛為骨幹，另置各道行軍總管、郡丞、縣令分守河北、河南、江都、涿郡、太原諸重鎮；地方兵制在大業九年詔天下郡縣置兵之後解體，鄉里民壯得以自備器械成軍，反而為起義者提供了兵源與將才。

起義方並非單一軍隊，而是數支互不統屬的武裝：王薄於山東長平首倡，張金稱、孫安祖、高智達在山東與河北聚眾，竇建德在河北樂壽建夏，翟讓、李密在河南瓦崗寨建魏，杜伏威在江淮起兵，蕭銑據江陵，梁師都據延安並倚突厥。每支武裝各自推舉首領，號令、糧秣、器械來源皆自定，彼此聯戰多靠臨時約定，並無統一的參謀與後勤系統。

鎮壓方面，隋廷倚重張須陀等地方宿將，以騎兵追擊、斷糧、圍剿為主，屢平山東河北數股勢力，但每次出動都耗去大批兵力與糧秣，中央禁軍由疲於奔命轉為空虛，軍心由此鬆散。江都之變後，隋廷再無力調度大軍，東西各割據者遂互相攻伐，混戰延續至唐初方定。
countriesEn:
The Sui side was organised around the Twelve Great Generals and the Five Armies of the imperial guard, with war commissioners, commandery magistrates and county prefects posted to hold the strategic towns of Hebei, Henan, Jiangdu, Zhuojun and Taiyuan. When the edict of 613 ordered every commandery and county to raise troops, the local military system came apart: village levies were permitted to arm themselves, and that single measure handed the insurgents both a ready reservoir of manpower and a supply of men who already knew how to handle weapons.

The rebel side was never a single army but a number of unrelated armed bands. Wang Bo raised the standard first at Changping in Shandong; Zhang Jincheng, Sun Anzu and Gao Zhida collected followers in Shandong and Hebei; Dou Jiande built the state of Xia around Leshou in Hebei; Zhai Rang and Li Mi established Wei at Wagang in Henan; Du Fuwei rose in the Jianghuai region; Xiao Xuan held Jiangling; and Liang Shudu stood at Yan'an with the support of the Turks. Every band chose its own leader, issued its own orders and found its own rations, pay and weapons, so that cooperation among them rested on temporary bargains rather than on any common staff or logistic system.

For suppression the court relied on provincial veterans such as Zhang Xutuo, whose method was to run the insurgents down with cavalry, cut their supply lines and then close in for the kill. He destroyed band after band in Shandong and Hebei, but every such expedition spent troops and provisions on a large scale, and the central guard, worn down by endless marching, grew hollow and its morale loosened. After the coup at Jiangdu in 618 the court could no longer concentrate field armies at all; the regional powers turned on one another instead, and that killing went on until the early Tang finally settled it.
people:
起義首倡者王薄是山東長平鄉民，他散傳歌謠、糾合鄉里，開隋末據兵自立之先例，隨後被隋軍列為重點追剿對象，兵敗之後去向不明。山東河北另有張金稱、孫安祖、高智達各領一軍，號召鄉里、掠取郡縣倉廩。

河北的竇建德以樂壽為中心收攏流散部眾，練兵習陣，進取河北諸州，武德元年稱夏王。河南瓦崗寨的翟讓先據山寨，李密後到，翟讓讓兵權於李密，李密整合山東河南諸股兵力，設官置將、編號部曲，兩人終因部眾分配反目，李密殺翟讓而獨掌軍權，隨後與宇文化及戰於洛陽北邙山大破之。杜伏威起兵江淮、蕭銑割據江陵、梁師都依託突厥立於延安，皆自立名號。唐方以太原起兵的李淵、李建成、李世民兄弟為核心，李世民自領兵後破王世充、擒竇建德、平劉黑闥，漸成隋末最大勝場。

隋廷一方有煬帝楊廣、弒君的宇文化及、據洛陽自稱鄭主的王世充；隋將張須陀轉戰山東河南，屢破張金稱等股，戰歿陣中，其部由秦瓊、程知節收編，後歸唐室，成為唐初兩員猛將。
peopleEn:
The first spark was Wang Bo, a villager of Changping in Shandong. He spread songs and ballads, drew the villages together and set the precedent for armed self-government that the last years of the Sui would follow; the court then made him a priority target, and after his defeat his whereabouts became unknown. In Shandong and Hebei, Zhang Jincheng, Sun Anzu and Gao Zhida each led a separate force, calling up the countryside and stripping the granaries of the commanderies they took.

In Hebei, Dou Jiande gathered scattered bands around Leshou, drilled his men, took up positions in the prefectures of Hebei and proclaimed himself King of Xia in the first year of Wude. At Wagang in Henan, Zhai Rang had occupied the stronghold first; Li Mi arrived later and Zhai Rang handed him command, after which Li Mi welded the various bands of Shandong and Henan into one force, created offices and ranks and numbered his units. The two men finally fell out over the distribution of followers, and Li Mi killed Zhai Rang to hold the army alone, then defeated Yuwen Huaji in the fighting north of Luoyang on Mount Mang. Du Fuwei rose in the Jianghuai region, Xiao Xuan carved out Jiangling, and Liang Shodu raised a state at Yan'an under Turkic protection, each with a title of his own. On the Tang side the core was the brothers Li Yuan, Li Jiancheng and Li Shimin, who rose at Taiyuan; from the moment he took charge of troops Li Shimin defeated Wang Shichong, captured Dou Jiande and destroyed Liu Heita, and became the largest winner of the late Sui.

On the Sui side stood Emperor Yang of Sui, Yuwen Huaji who murdered him, and Wang Shichong, who held Luoyang and styled himself ruler of Zheng. The Sui general Zhang Xutuo campaigned through Shandong and Henan, broke Zhang Jincheng and other bands repeatedly, and was killed in the field; his troops were taken over by Qin Qiong and Cheng Zhijie, who later joined the Tang and became two of its formidable commanders.
kits:
本場戰爭的守城骨幹是弩兵，而秦連弩是其中最見於記載的機括式強弩。戰國至秦，連弩已見實物：1970年代湖北雲夢睡虎地秦墓出土的竹木弩機，銅製機牙、阻鐵與雙層箭槽保存如新，箭槽可容箭約三十支，弩機把拉力蓄在機括之中，踩動機牙即可逐箭發射，不必每發重上弦，這是已知最早的連發弩機形制。

隋代承此餘緒，弩是城防與野戰的骨幹裝備，《隋書》與《資治通鑑》所記的守城弩手、蹶張弩、床弩，射速與覆蓋面遠勝弓矢；攻高句麗之役，隋軍除用雲梯、巢車、塹車、拋石車外，亦以弩陣封鎖城郊通道。隋末亂局中，弓弩成為起義軍繳獲最多的官軍器械之一：山東河北的義軍破縣城、奪武庫之後，弩機與箭矢立刻用於反攻州郡；瓦崗軍造臨車、巢車、撞車、拋石車逼近洛陽，與城頭弩手隔塹對射。

連弩的優勢在守城，一次上箭可連發數十矢，能長時間封鎖城門與登城通道，減少拉弦的體力與時間；局限則是射程不及床弩一類大弩，箭匣存量有限，發射節奏一旦被亂軍或拋石擊毀箭匣即難以維持。雙方在裝備體系上的差距，隨着起義軍由徒手鄉民轉為繳械步卒、再轉為帶甲騎兵而逐步拉平，最後以器械數量與騎兵質量決定了攻守易勢。
kitsEn:
The backbone of defence in this war was the crossbow corps, and the Qin repeating crossbow is the best-attested of the magazine-type heavy crossbows. The mechanism was already known from the Warring States and Qin periods: a bamboo-and-timber crossbow trigger assembly excavated in the 1970s from the Qin tombs at Shuihudi, Yunmeng in Hubei still carries its bronze sear, its trigger plate and its double-row bolt channel, the channel holding on the order of thirty bolts. The tension is stored in the mechanism itself; the sear is tripped and the bolts are released one after another, so the bow need not be restrung for every shot. This is among the earliest known repeating crossbow mechanisms.

The Sui inherited that line of development. The crossbow was the standard weapon of both wall defence and field work, and the crossbowmen, hand-drawn heavy crossbows and platform crossbows recorded in the histories of Sui and Zizhi Tongjian outranged and outpaced the bow in rate of fire and area of cover. In the campaigns against Goguryeo the Sui army used ladders, siege towers, mantlets and stone-throwers, and also sealed the approaches to the city walls with masses of crossbow fire. Once disorder broke out in the last years of the Sui, bows and crossbows became the most frequently captured items of Sui ordnance. Rebels in Shandong and Hebei who stormed county seats and emptied the arsenaries turned the crossbows and their bolts at once against the prefectures they wanted; the Wagang army built mobile siege towers, battering towers, stone-throwers and fire-carts against Luoyang, trading volleys with the crossbowmen on the ramparts across the ditch.

The advantage of the repeating crossbow lay in defence. A single loading of bolts permitted dozens of shots in succession, holding the gates and the wall approaches under continuous fire with far less time and effort spent on drawing the string. Its limits were equally clear: its range fell short of that of the large platform crossbows, the magazine held only a limited number of bolts, and once the rhythm of fire was broken, or the magazine was shattered by rubble or stone-throwers, the weapon could no longer sustain its rate. The gap in equipment between the two sides closed step by step as the insurgents moved from unarmed villagers to shod foot soldiers and then to armoured cavalry, and in the end the sheer quantity of captured ordnance and the quality of the horses decided which way the balance of attack and defence tipped.
tactics:
起義初起，隊伍多為手持耒耜、扁擔與削尖竹竿的鄉民，人數雜、紀律散，戰法只有兩端：一是趁郡縣吏卒分散、夜間突襲縣城倉廩，奪糧奪馬之後即散；二是退入山澤結寨立柵，利用地形與官軍不熟而游走。隋廷的鎮壓則以騎兵為骨幹，靠速度切斷糧道、再合圍殲滅，張須陀在山東河北追擊數千里，多用此法；其弱點是糧秣難繼、援兵不齊，一旦被拖入山地攻堅，騎兵優勢即減。

起義軍壯大後轉入攻城，攻城手段變得完整：先以填壕車平溝塹，再以臨車、巢車逼近城頭，以車板直抵城堞，再用撞車撞門、火車火箭焚燒城樓；城頭弩手的射界被車體遮蔽，攻方的折損多集中於填壕與接近城牆的瞬間。洛陽攻防最典型，隋城守軍以弩矢與飛石覆蓋城外每一條接近線，攻方屢受挫，後改以巢車疊進並配合夜襲內部奪門才奏效。瓦崗軍破宇文化及的邙山之戰是另一套打法：先以一部挑戰引追，敵軍越過山口再全軍掩上，騎兵在狹窄地形中衝亂其行列。虎牢關之戰則是李世民以三千餘精騎誘竇建德十餘萬眾渡汜水，佯退縱之，敵陣拉長而後精騎大縱衝擊，一戰而潰其前軍。

整體而言，隋末戰局由騎兵打散步兵逐步逆轉為以繳獲之械造攻城器、以繳獲之馬建騎兵，裝備來源的此消彼長，比任何一場會戰都更決定了勝負。
tacticsEn:
At the outset the rebel bands consisted of villagers carrying spades, shoulder poles and sharpened bamboo poles; their numbers were mixed and their discipline thin, and their methods took only two forms. Either they struck at night at county seats while the local officials and soldiers were scattered, seizing grain and horses and then dispersing again; or they withdrew into the hills, stockaded themselves and wandered there, turning the unfamiliar terrain against the government troops. Suppression by the court rested on cavalry, whose speed was used to cut supply lines and then close the net; Zhang Xutuo pursued the insurgents for hundreds of li across Shandong and Hebei in exactly this way. The weakness of that method was the difficulty of keeping the cavalry fed and of concentrating reinforcements: once dragged into hill country for a deliberate assault, the advantage of cavalry diminished.

Once the insurgents grew strong enough, they turned to sieges and their methods became complete. Ditch-filling carts levelled the trenches; mobile towers and siege towers were brought up to the wall so that their platforms reached the parapets; battering rams were driven against the gates and fire-carts and incendiary arrows were used against the gate towers. The crossbowmen on the ramparts had their firing lanes covered by the screening of the siege vehicles, and the assault troops' losses fell mainly in the moments of filling the ditch and closing on the wall. The siege of Luoyang is the clearest case: the Sui garrison covered every approach outside the walls with crossbow bolts and stone missiles, the assault was repulsed again and again, and only when the towers were advanced in overlapping stages and a night assault was launched from within, to take the gates, did the city fall. The battle of Mount Mang in which the Wagang army broke Yuwen Huaji was a different pattern again: a part of the force provoked and pursued the enemy, drew it past the mountain mouth, and then the whole army fell on it, the cavalry tearing the enemy columns apart in narrow ground. The battle of Hulao was the same logic inverted: Li Shimin took three thousand cavalry and let Dou Jiande's host of more than a hundred thousand cross the Si River, pretended to retreat, released them, and then charged with the picked cavalry the moment the enemy column had stretched out, breaking the vanguard in a single stroke.

Overall the situation of the late Sui reversed from cavalry beating scattered infantry to the insurgents building siege engines from captured ordnance and cavalry from captured horses. The balance of captured equipment, more than any single engagement, decided the war.
data:
《隋書·地理志》記隋朝極盛時州郡所統戶口合計約八百九十餘萬戶、四千六百餘萬口，其中京師一帶約七十六萬戶，洛陽二十餘萬戶，是當時天下第一等的繁盛都市。大業年間三次征高句麗，《資治通鑑》記大業八年那次出兵至百十三萬人、餽糧相稱，自此天下府庫為之一空，役使與轉輸的沉重落到每一州縣。開皇九年天下兵器曾盡聚京師，隋廷倚以控馭四方；大業九年改置天下郡縣兵，鄉里自備器械者驟增，兵源一時寬廣，卻再難以統一編制。

虎牢關之役，竇建德引兵號稱十餘萬來救洛陽，李世民所部精騎僅三千餘人，兩軍人數懸殊而結局相反：竇軍前軍被縱騎衝散，主力潰於汜水東岸，竇建德本人於牛口渚被擒。洛陽攻城自武德四年春延續至五月，唐軍以巢車逼近城頭，屢遭城上弩箭與飛石，攻城士卒折損頗重，最終王世充出降。

戰亂整體自大業六年末延續到武德五六年間，主要割據勢力先後覆滅：竇建德在武德四年被擒，王世充同年降，劉黑闥在武德六年前後被平，輔公祏同年敗亡，至此北方才大體安靖。雲夢秦墓出土的連弩弩機，一匣雙槽可容箭約三十支，連發數十矢不成問題，惟機體笨重，長途行軍仍以單兵張弩與手弩為主。
dataEn:
The Geography Treatise of the History of Sui records that at the height of the dynasty the commanderies and counties together held on the order of 8.9 million households and some 46 million people, of which the capital region accounted for about 760,000 households and Luoyang for more than 200,000, making it the largest and richest city of the age. The three campaigns against Goguryeo in the Daye years drained the treasury: the Zizhi Tongjian records that in the 612 expedition the armies numbered as many as 1,130,000 men with provisions to match, and from that point the state's storehouses were emptied and the burden of service and transport fell on every commandery. Under the Kaihuang reign the weapons of the whole realm were gathered into the capital, which the court relied on to hold the provinces in check; the edict of 613 that ordered commanderies and counties to raise troops suddenly widened the pool of armed village men, at the same time making uniform organisation of them impossible.

At Hulao, Dou Jiande brought in a host numbering, by his own account, more than one hundred thousand to relieve Luoyang, while Li Shimin had barely three thousand picked cavalry. The two armies were wildly unequal in numbers and the outcome was the reverse of what the numbers suggested: the Sui–Xia vanguard was scattered by the charge of the cavalry, the main body broke on the east bank of the Si River, and Dou Jiande himself was captured at Niukou Landing. The siege of Luoyang ran from the spring of the first year of Wude until May. The Tang army brought siege towers up to the wall, was repeatedly struck by crossbow bolts and stone missiles from above, and lost a good number of assault soldiers, until in the end Wang Shichong came out and surrendered.

Taken as a whole, the war ran from the winter of 610 to the middle of the sixth year of Wude, with the principal regional powers destroyed one after another: Dou Jiande taken alive in the fourth year of Wude, Wang Shichong surrendering in the same year, Liu Heita put down around the sixth year, and Fu Gongshi defeated in that year as well, after which the north was broadly quiet. The repeating crossbow trigger excavated from the Qin tombs at Yunmeng held some thirty bolts in its twin channels and could fire them in long succession without difficulty, but the machine was heavy, and on long marches the single-man drawn crossbow and the hand crossbow remained the practical weapons.
cause:
直接動因是隋文帝晚年的治國積累被隋煬帝的窮兵黷武一次引爆。文帝平陳之後休養生息、開皇年間倉廩充盈，煬帝即位卻把國策整個扭轉：先開鑿運河、大築東都洛陽，再三度征討高句麗，役使與兵糧的攤派按州縣加額，長安洛陽的營造與巡幸又耗去大量人力物力。

與此同時，大業年間連年的水旱與饑饉壓在河北、山東一帶，州縣吏員催科無度，屯田與均田的實際收益被水旱和豪強侵吞兩面擠壓，鄉里不得不自求武裝自保。天災之外還有制度性的斷裂：開皇九年天下兵器盡收京師，地方久無兵備；大業九年朝廷詔置天下郡縣兵，起義一旦爆發便再無兵源門檻。權力中樞本身亦已失衡，煬帝猜忌宗室，大業十三年越王侑立為皇太子、榆次宮之變誅楊勇，宗室與功臣人人自危。

於是大業七年山東長平王薄散傳歌謠舉兵，四方響應，河北竇建德、河南李密、江淮杜伏威相繼而起，鎮壓一次、復起一次，最終把隋朝的兵與糧同時耗空。
causeEn:
The immediate cause was the collapse of the accumulated substance of Sui Wendi's late reign under the war policy of Emperor Yang. After bringing the Chen dynasty to an end, Wendi had let the state recover, and the granaries had filled during the Kaihuang years. Yang reversed the whole policy of the state on taking the throne: first the canals were cut and the eastern capital at Luoyang built on a vast scale, then three campaigns were launched against Goguryeo, with the levies for men and grain apportioned in increased quotas on the commanderies, while the construction works in the two capitals and the imperial progresses further consumed labour and materials.

At the same time, repeated floods, droughts and famines in the Daye years fell on Hebei and Shandong, where county officials exacted dues without limit, and the actual returns from the state fields and the equal-field system were squeezed from two sides at once, by the weather and by the encroachment of the powerful landholders, so that villages had to arm themselves to protect themselves. Beyond the natural disasters there was a structural break: under Kaihuang the weapons of the realm had been gathered into the capital and the provinces had long been without defence; the edict of 613 that ordered troops to be raised in every commandery and county removed any threshold on the supply of arms, so that once the revolt began it could not be contained. The centre of power was itself out of balance: Yang distrusted the imperial clan, and in 617 the appointment of Prince Yue Yu as heir and the purge of Yang Yong at the Yuci palace left the princes and the great officers each insecure in their own position.

Accordingly, in 611 Wang Bo of Changping in Shandong distributed songs and raised his banner, the four quarters answered, and Dou Jiande in Hebei, Li Mi in Henan and Du Fuwei in the Jianghuai rose in turn. Suppression was followed by a new rising, and again by a new rising, until the troops and the grain of the Sui were exhausted at the same moment.
impact:
這場戰爭的直接結果是隋亡唐興，但它留下的東西比王朝更長。制度上，隋朝創立的三省六部、州縣兩級建制、科舉取士與租庸調框架，經唐初全面承接並逐步改造，成為此後數百年的行政底盤；唐代在隋制之上改的，是因戰亂而失效的部分：均田因戶籍崩壞而難以核查，租庸調因農戶流散而徵收不實，最終在開元天寶年間經兩稅法改為按資產與戶口徵稅，財政重心由租調轉向兩稅，再由兩稅轉向鹽鐵與商稅。

戰亂也把邊疆形勢徹底改寫：梁師都倚突厥而立，劉黑闥敗走之後亦賴突厥收留，高句麗趁隋虛弱重整併吞北邊的附庸小國，粟末靺鞨首領大祚榮在唐初建立渤海國，契丹、奚等部落則在北方草原分立，隋朝原本設於東北與西域的一整套羈縻與郡縣安排蕩然無存，邊防成本此後由唐一代代承擔。

兵制上，府兵制在戰後殘兵歸農、騎兵與器械散落民間，一度名存實亡，直到武則天與玄宗先後改制募兵，兵源與兵種才重新洗牌。技術上，弩機連發一類的守城器械經唐代文獻整理而延續，攻城器械與守城器械的長期競逐，客觀上推動了中國攻城技術與投石、衝撞器械的進步。
impactEn:
The immediate result of the war was the fall of the Sui and the rise of the Tang, but what it left behind outlasted either dynasty. Institutionally, the three departments and six ministries, the two-tier commandery and county system, the examination system and the framework of rent, labour and commutation taxes created by the Sui were taken over wholesale by the early Tang and gradually remade, becoming the administrative bedrock of the following centuries. What the Tang changed on top of the Sui system were precisely the parts that the war had rendered useless: the equal-field system could no longer be checked once the registers were broken, and rent, labour and commutation taxes could no longer be collected accurately once the farming households had scattered, until in the Kaiyuan and Tianbao years the two-tax law replaced them with taxes on property and household, moving the centre of finance from the levies to the two taxes, and from the two taxes to the salt and iron monopolies and to commercial dues.

The war also rewrote the frontier completely. Liang Shudu stood on Turkic support, and Liu Heita was likewise received by the Turks after his defeat; Goguryeo, taking advantage of Sui weakness, reorganised itself and swallowed the smaller client states on its northern border; the leader of the Sushen Mohe, Da Zuorong, founded the state of Balhae in the early Tang; and peoples such as the Khitan and the Xi split apart into separate powers on the northern steppe. The whole Sui apparatus of protectorates and commanderies in the northeast and the western regions was swept away, and the cost of the northern frontier was thereafter carried by the Tang generation after generation.

In military organisation the fubing system fell into name only after the war, with demobilised soldiers returning to the fields and cavalry and ordnance scattered among the people, until Wu Zetian and then Xuanzong reformed the system toward recruited troops and the sources and kinds of soldier were shuffled once more. In technology the repeating crossbow and its kin, the leading siege-defence weapons, were carried forward by the documentation of the Tang, and the long contest between siege engines and wall defences objectively drove Chinese progress in siegecraft, stone-throwing and battering machines.
result:
十八年江都之變，宇文化及弒隋煬帝，掌握各地兵權；越王侑在洛陽即位為皇泰主，幽州總管王祥奉詔送之入都，隋朝空架子又撐了數年。王世充在洛陽迫皇泰主遜位，國號鄭；李淵於太原起兵，先後取長安洛陽，帝號唐，與王世充、竇建德三分天下。

李密破宇文化及於邙山，兵威及於河南，然而糧道斷絕、士卒疲耗，終為王世充所乘，敗走之後降唐，未幾叛走被誅。竇建德與唐爭河北，武德四年五月虎牢關一戰，李世民以精騎破其十餘萬眾，竇建德被擒送長安，河北悉平；同年十月唐軍克洛陽，王世充降，隋朝在中原的殘餘武力被清空。河北劉黑闥曾乘隙再起，洺水一戰再度覆亡，敗走突厥終為所擒；江淮輔公祏以杜伏威舊部反唐，兵敗被平；延安梁師都倚突厥抗唐，部將降而其人兵敗被殺。

戰亂的東段至此一一歸於唐室，隋末農民戰爭所釋放出來的兵源、馬匹、器械與地方控制力，成為唐得以迅速消化、轉為對外用兵之本的資源。唐隨後滅東突厥、平高句麗、征西域，多半是在這場戰爭清空舊秩序之後才有可能展開。回頭看，隋末的崩潰並非出於一場會戰的勝負，而是費役、兵糧、災荒與制度斷裂同時到頂的結果；起義軍以最樸素的鄉村武裝起步，靠繳獲迅速成長，最終改寫了王朝更替的節奏，也改寫了此後數百年中國對待邊疆與財政的基本方式。
resultEn:
At the coup at Jiangdu in 618, Yuwen Huaji murdered Emperor Yang and took control of the military power of the various regions. Prince Yue Yu was enthroned at Luoyang as Huangtai Lord, and the Yanbei commander Wang Xiang carried the imperial order to bring him to the capital; the empty shell of the Sui held on for several more years. Wang Shichong forced the Huangtai Lord to abdicate at Luoyang and took the state name of Zheng; Li Yuan rose at Taiyuan, took Chang'an and then Luoyang, proclaimed himself emperor of Tang, and the realm was divided three ways between him, Wang Shichong and Dou Jiande.

Li Mi broke Yuwen Huaji at Mount Mang and his armies reached across Henan, but his supply line was cut, his soldiers were worn out, and in the end he was taken advantage of by Wang Shichong; after his defeat he surrendered to the Tang, and not long afterwards he broke away and was put to death. Dou Jiande fought the Tang for Hebei, and in the battle of Hulao in the fifth month of the fourth year of Wude Li Shimin broke his host of more than a hundred thousand with picked cavalry; Dou Jiande was taken alive and sent to Chang'an, and Hebei was quieted. In the tenth month of the same year the Tang took Luoyang, Wang Shichong surrendered, and the last Sui military force in the central plain was cleared away. In Hebei Liu Heita rose once more in a gap that opened, and was destroyed a second time at the battle of Mingshui before being captured after fleeing to the Turks. In the Jianghuai, Fu Gongshi rebelled against the Tang with the old troops of Du Fuwei and was put down after defeat. At Yan'an, Liang Shudu had relied on Turkic support to resist the Tang; his officers surrendered and he was killed when his army failed.

The eastern half of the war was thus reduced one by one to the Tang, and the manpower, horses, ordnance and control of the localities released by the Sui peasant war became the resources the Tang could absorb quickly and convert into the base for wars abroad. The Tang's later destruction of the Eastern Turks, its campaigns against Goguryeo and its expeditions into the west were in most cases possible only because this war had emptied the old order out. Looking back, the collapse of the Sui did not come from the result of any single engagement but from the simultaneous peaking of service levies, military and grain supply, natural disaster and structural breakdown; the insurgents began with the plainest village weapons, grew quickly on what they captured, and in the end changed the tempo of dynastic replacement, as well as the basic way China would treat its frontier and its finances for centuries afterwards.
